why: the callback type belongs to the guard condition rather than to the executor's `add` call, because it is bound to the entity (RFC-0041). rcl's counterpart is the `rclc_gc_callback_t` passed to `rclc_executor_add_guard_condition` -- the `executor-owns-no-entity-storage` rule, seen as a type. See `c:subscription_callback_t`. Since phase-417 W4.e it is a parameter of `rclc_node_create_guard_condition`, which is where the binding now happens; nothing installs it after the fact.
